text: BREAKING: Experts are "concerned." Experts have been concerned since 1987. Tiktokistan has fired all experts and replaced them with one man who is never concerned. Me.
Today's news was read by 40 million people and understood by 6. Those 6 have been placed on the Traitor List for knowing too much.
Every headline today ends with a question mark. In Tiktokistan, questions are taxed. The newspapers owe me a fortune.
A study found that studies find things. Funding approved. The Ministry of Science now reports to me.
"Sources say." Which sources? In Tiktokistan there is one source. It is me. And I say: go away.
The news cycle is now 11 minutes long. My attention span is 9. I have declared the remaining 2 minutes a national holiday.
Another company "apologised." In Tiktokistan, an apology costs 50 coins and must be delivered on one knee. Prices rise on Mondays.
Every morning I read the headlines so my citizens don't have to. Then I tell them everything is fine. That is called leadership.
BREAKING: Something happened. Opinions were posted. Nobody changed their mind. This concludes today's news.
The internet has found a new thing to be angry about. It will be forgotten by Thursday. I remember everything. Especially who was angry at me.
A celebrity said something. Another celebrity responded. Both have been appointed Ministers of Nothing. Unpaid.
"Breaking news" used to mean news. Now it means a man filmed his lunch and 3 million people watched. In Tiktokistan he would be Minister of Lunch.
Today's top story is that people are tired. Correct. They are tired because they keep reading the top stories.
They say the markets are "volatile." My mood is also volatile. Nobody writes articles about my mood. This is a scandal.
A billionaire did something. Billionaires always do something. I am also rich and do nothing. Who is the real visionary here.
Every week a headline says "the end of an era." There are no eras left. You people ended all of them.
Weather forecast for Tiktokistan: sunny, because I said so. Clouds have been deported.
Read the comments under any news story and you will understand why I rule alone.
A brand posted a statement about "our values." Brands do not have values. They have prices. Mine are very reasonable.
Scientists say people should sleep 8 hours. Doomscrollers sleep 4 and spend the other 4 reading that they should sleep 8.
Someone went viral for being normal for 30 seconds. Standards have collapsed. I am drafting new standards. They are about me.
A headline promised "you won't believe what happened next." I didn't. I never believe anything. This is why I am still in charge.
The new trend is "going analog." Congratulations, you have discovered paper. Tiktokistan invented paper. I sign it all day without reading it.
The algorithm decided what you are angry about today. You agreed instantly. Very obedient. I am taking notes.
Press release: "We take this very seriously." Translation: we will post a beige square and wait for the weekend.
A headline asked "Is it over for this?" Nothing is ever over anymore. It just gets a sequel and a podcast.
Every app is adding AI. Every toaster is adding AI. Tiktokistan added AI to its Prime Minister and he is still grumpy.
BREAKING: A man on the internet was wrong. Rescue teams have been sent. They are also wrong.
Inflation is when you pay more for less. Tiktokistan calls this "taxes" and I call it "Tuesday."
The news says "people are divided." Good. Divided people are easier to govern. Thank you, news.
Another "update to our terms of service." Nobody read it. I read it. I now own your thumbs.
An influencer apologised in a 14-minute video wearing a grey hoodie. The grey hoodie is now illegal in Tiktokistan for crimes against sincerity.
A new survey says 73% of people trust nothing. The other 27% are lying. I trust the 73%.
Every day there is a "huge leak." In Tiktokistan, leaks are punished. Except mine. Mine are strategic.
Today's discourse: a sandwich. Yesterday's discourse: a different sandwich. Tomorrow someone gets cancelled over the sandwich.
Headlines scare you, then the ads sell you the cure. In Tiktokistan I cut out the middleman. I scare you AND sell you the cure.
"Experts warn." Experts always warn. Has an expert ever said "relax"? I say relax. That is why I am not an expert. I am a Prime Minister.
Somewhere a company just announced "restructuring to improve efficiency." In Tiktokistan, I improve efficiency by not working at all.
A company says its new product will "change everything." I checked. My mood is unchanged.
Hot take season is open. Everyone gets one hot take. Mine: you are all wrong. Season closed.
Every "unprecedented" thing has a precedent. Read a book. Not that one. A good one. About me.
A morning show said "let's talk about wellbeing" and then read nine terrifying headlines in a row. Classic.
DECREE #1: The Republic of Tiktokistan is open to defectors. Bring your thumbs. Leave your opinions at the border.
Tiktokistan has the strongest economy in the world. I checked my own pockets. Very strong.
I have never accepted a bribe. I have accepted many gifts that happened to be shaped exactly like bribes. Different thing.
The Traitor List grew by 14 names today. Reasons include: "said bro," "typed slowly," and "looked at me funny through the screen."
Reminder: the Palace is open whenever I go LIVE on TikTok. Attendance is voluntary. Absence is noted.
New tax: the Emoji Tax. Each emoji costs one coin. The skull emoji costs three because it is disrespectful.
The Ministry of Rizz has failed again. The Minister has been demoted to Minister of Folding Chairs.
A citizen asked why the roads in Tiktokistan have potholes. Walk better. Next question.
We held a fair and free poll today. 98% chose option B. Option A was not available. Democracy has spoken.
My portrait in the office is now 4 metres tall. Next month: 5. Growth is important.
Today's Banned Word is "literally." I literally cannot stand it. That sentence earns me a strike. I pardon myself.
The Evil Twin attempted another coup last night. He failed. The Coalition saved me. I will never thank them publicly.
Every great nation has a national anthem. Ours is me sighing into the microphone. Very moving. Several citizens cried.
Ministers of Tiktokistan, a reminder: loyalty is free. Disloyalty is also free, but only once.
The National Treasury is filling up nicely. I will not say how full. I will only say my new boots are very shiny.
New law: every message must end with "long live the PM." Yes, even breakups. Especially breakups.
I have appointed a Minister of Delulu. She believes she is doing an excellent job. Perfect fit.
Citizens complain the Palace is too loud. The Palace is not loud. You are quiet. Fix yourselves.
Tiktokistan's official bird is the pigeon. I am not afraid of pigeons. That rumour is fake news and its author is on the list.
Pardons are now available. Not for sale. Never for sale. They are earned. Through loyalty. And luck. Mostly my mood.
Our border is wide open for doomscrollers who wish to defect. Entry paperwork: none. Exit paperwork: 4,000 pages.
The Deputy PM asked for a raise. Request denied. The Deputy PM has been moved to a higher shelf in the storage room.
Annual report on the state of Tiktokistan: excellent. Written by me, reviewed by me, approved by me. Unanimous.
Tonight in the Palace: Loyalty Checks, a rigged poll and possibly a meltdown. Bring snacks. Do not bring opinions.
Doomscroller, you have been scrolling for 3 hours. Your thumb has applied for asylum in Tiktokistan. Granted.
You opened the app "for one minute" 46 minutes ago. I am not angry. I am writing it down.
Doomscrollers think they are staying informed. They are staying horizontal.
To every doomscroller reading this at 3 AM: go to sleep. Not for your health. I just need fewer witnesses.
You have scrolled past 900 posts today and remembered none of them. Remember this one. I am your Prime Minister now.
The average doomscroller moves their thumb 9 kilometres a month. In Tiktokistan that is taxed as transport.
Doomscrolling is just reading the same bad mood in 40 different fonts.
A doomscroller told me they "take breaks." Yes. Breaks to open a different app.
Doomscrollers, I see you liking posts without reading them. In Tiktokistan we call that civil service.
You say you are addicted to your phone. Your phone says the same about you. Toxic relationship. I approve. It keeps you busy.
Scroll. Sigh. Scroll. Sigh. Scroll. This is the sound of a doomscroller, and also our national anthem.
Doomscroller amnesty is open. Stop scrolling, defect to Tiktokistan, and your past scrolling is forgiven. Except liking your own posts.
Your screen time report came in. It says "concerning." Mine says "Prime Ministerial."
Doomscrollers don't have hobbies. They have tabs.
You read 12 threads about productivity today and produced nothing. Impressive. Perfect civil servant material.
Doomscroller, put the phone down for one minute. ... You didn't. I knew it. Traitor List, row 88.
Every doomscroller says "just one more." My Finance Minister says the same thing about coins. Both are lying.
The blue light on your face at 2 AM is not a glow-up. It is a confession.
This app has a For You tab. Nothing on it is for me. I have reported the algorithm to the Ministry of Censorship.
Everyone here has a checkmark now. In Tiktokistan, checkmarks are earned through loyalty. Here they are earned with a card number. Disgraceful. I respect it.
Ratio attempts on my posts will be counted, logged and forwarded to the Deportation Office.
On this app, "engagement" means 400 strangers yelling at one stranger. In Tiktokistan we call that a cabinet meeting.
Every reply guy here thinks he is a Minister. None of you are Ministers. Ministries are earned in the Palace.
The algorithm and I have something in common. We both decide what you think, and neither of us explains why.
People here quote-post to dunk on each other. In Tiktokistan, dunking is a crime. The punishment is being quote-posted by me.
The trending tab is just strangers arguing in alphabetical order.
You can edit posts here now. In Tiktokistan, I edit history. Bigger feature.
Community Notes would like to add context to this post. Context: I am always right.
This app is called X because nobody could agree on anything else. Typical committee. In Tiktokistan, I name things alone.
Every day someone here announces they are leaving this app. Every day they come back. In Tiktokistan, leaving is not allowed. Saves time.
A new phone came out with one more camera. Now you can ignore your life from five angles.
Every startup says it is "disrupting" something. In Tiktokistan, disruption earns you a strike.
They built an AI that writes poems. I built a Prime Minister who ignores poems. Who is more advanced.
Smart fridge. Smart watch. Smart ring. Everything is smart now except the people buying them.
Tech billionaires want to go to space. Fine. Go. Tiktokistan will look after your yachts.
My phone asked to update. I asked my phone for loyalty. Neither of us got what we wanted.
A tech CEO said his product will "make the world better." My product is me. The world is already better.
New gadget launch: it does what your old gadget did, but thinner and more expensive. Like your patience.
Every app wants access to my location. My location is the Palace. Permission denied.
A headset that lets you live in a virtual world. Doomscrollers already live in a virtual world. This one just costs more.
Tech companies say "we value your privacy." I value your privacy too. I keep a list of it.
They call it the cloud. It is someone else's computer. In Tiktokistan, it is my computer. Everything is my computer.
Humans invented the wheel, the printing press and the internet, and use all three to complain.
People say "I'm not like other people." Everyone says this. You are exactly like other people. That is why you are all on the list.
Humanity's greatest skill: reading two lines and having an opinion about the whole book.
You don't want advice. You want someone to agree with you. I agree with no one. That is why I am in charge.
Monday is not the problem. You are the problem. Monday is just when you notice.
People spend all week waiting for the weekend and all weekend dreading Monday. Tiktokistan has abolished weekends. Problem solved.
Everyone wants to be "authentic" until someone is authentic at them.
Humans will wait 40 minutes for brunch and refuse to wait 4 seconds for a page to load.
"Let's circle back" means never. "Per my last email" means you are about to be deported.
Nobody reads the instructions. Then they read 200 reviews about why the thing doesn't work.
A person who says "I'm brutally honest" is mostly brutal and occasionally honest. I am both, fully. Also handsome.
Humanity's motto: "Someone should do something." Tiktokistan's motto: "Not me."
